_note: Writing Sample : jusqu'à 30 s pour lire, puis jusqu'à 5 min. Guide 2026 §4.7.

items.prompt: Describe the qualities of a good leader. Use examples from your own experience.
What is the most useful thing you have learned outside of school? Explain why it was important.
How has the internet changed the way people look for information? Give specific examples.
Describe an environmental problem in your country and suggest one solution.
Describe a place in your city that you would show to a visitor. Explain why.
Some people say that stress can be positive. Do you agree? Explain with examples.
Describe a trip that changed the way you see the world.
Is it better to spend money on experiences or on objects? Explain your opinion.
What is one tradition from your culture that you would like to keep alive? Explain why.
Describe a hobby you would like to start and explain what attracts you to it.
How have eating habits changed in your country in recent years? Are these changes positive?
Would you prefer a job with a high salary and long hours, or a lower salary with more free time? Explain.
Describe a teacher who had a strong influence on you and explain what made them special.
Do you think artificial intelligence will create more jobs than it destroys? Explain your view.
Describe a challenge you faced and what you learned from it.
Should people be encouraged to have fewer cars, even if public transport is not perfect? Explain.
